valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E non-GAAP diluted EPS per ADS in USD viewed at the 12-month target date; 1 ADS = 5 ordinary shares)

bear.driver: Gaming revenue softness, domestic competition, and slower pipeline monetization
bear.assumption: FY2027E EPS $12.00 per ADS at 10.0x P/E

base.driver: Steady core franchise performance, Where Winds Meet global contribution, and 2027 pipeline launches
base.assumption: FY2027E EPS $14.00 per ADS at 11.5x P/E

bull.driver: Stronger-than-expected global game launches (e.g., Ananta), margin expansion, and ongoing buybacks
bull.assumption: FY2027E EPS $15.50 per ADS at 12.5x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $14.00, the $122.18 close implies 8.7x P/E; the 5-analyst weighted target (~$161.18) implies 11.5x P/E at base EPS (or $14.02 EPS at 11.5x).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $14.00 (11.5 pp of upside).
valuation.watch_metric: Online games net revenue growth and deferred revenue balance

analyst_notes: Following Q2 2026 earnings on August 20, 2026, 4 of the 5 tracked named analysts updated or reiterated their views in late August (J.P. Morgan at $180, Goldman Sachs at $168 from $169, CMB International at $160 from $155, Barclays at $132), and Morgan Stanley reiterated Overweight at $163 on September 28, 2026. The 5-analyst sample is skewed toward Buy (4 Buy, 1 Hold) and sits closely in line with the $161.00 base case (~0.1 pp gap), with Barclays' $132 Hold target reflecting a more conservative stance on near-term entertainment spending.
